clinical_trials.brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety and tolerability of Bruton's Tyrosine Kinase (Btk) Inhibitor PCI-32765 in Japanese patients with recurrent mature B-cell neoplasms.

relevance.reasoning: Phase 1 BTK 抑制劑（ibrutinib/PCI-32765）用於復發 B 細胞惡性腫瘤，15 人，已完成。直接評估人類成熟 B 細胞腫瘤中的 BTK 靶點驗證、安全性與早期療效，為此廣義分類最直接的臨床數據。
